Church member John M. Bernhisel copied portions of an Old Testament manuscript and a separate New Testament manuscript about a year after Joseph Smith’s death when Emma Smith loaned Bernhisel the manuscripts for a period of about three months. Bernhisel’s copy, though sincerely attempted, perpetuated some transcription errors (Matthews,“A Plainer Translation,”117–40.)

See Scott H. Faulring, Kent P. Jackson, and Robert J. Matthews, eds.,Joseph Smith’s New Translation of the Bible: Original Manuscripts(Provo, Utah: Religious Studies Center, Brigham Young University, 2004);“Bible Revision Manuscripts,”josephsmithpapers.org.
